data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table, the syndicate shows a net prior-year release of approximately GBP 71.4m (a reduction of ~12.2% of opening gross claims outstanding). This movement is driven by favourable development across older underwriting years (2011-2015). Closing gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2017 per the gross claims development table is GBP 670.419m; the opening (prior year closing) gross claims outstanding used for the percentage calculation is GBP 584.167m. Figures were derived from the gross claims development table (claims development triangle) as a fallback source; no explicit gross prior-year movement line was located in the notes.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary reserve and prior-year movement figures were derived from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 43 because a clear gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note was not found. Opening reserves are taken as the prior-year closing gross claims from the triangle (584,167k). Prior-year development was calculated by comparing each older underwriting year's current estimate to its previous diagonal (triangle method) and summing for UW years 2011-2015; this is a fallback method per instructions. Gross premium total and premium mix were not clearly extractable from the scanned pages; gross premium total is an approximate read from the underwriting analysis table and premium mix entries were not reliably parsed. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (GBP). Confidence levels reflect use of the triangle as a fallback.
